# Widefleet control plane

The management server and API for Widefleet, an open-source, self-hosted platform for internal apps and workflows. This image also includes database and storage initialization tools.

Follow the [self-hosting guide](https://widefleet.com/docs/self-hosting/installation) to configure and run the complete installation.

[Website](https://widefleet.com) · [Documentation](https://widefleet.com/docs) · [Source code](https://github.com/widefleet/widefleet)
